title: EditLens: Quantifying the Extent of AI Editing in Text
excerpt: An ICLR 2026 paper proposing lightweight similarity metrics and a regression model (EditLens) to quantify the magnitude of AI editing in text, achieving strong F1 scores on binary (94.7%) and ternary (90.4%) classification for distinguishing human, AI-generated, and mixed writing. The work has implications for authorship attribution, education, and policy.
